verdict.rationale: Perplexity's docs tell developers to install 'one of our official SDKs for a convenient, type-safe integration'. The official perplexity-py GitHub repo backs this up with full type definitions, sync and async clients, SSE streaming, automatic retries with backoff, typed API errors, and a search.create usage example. missing for 10: named and documented SDKs for languages beyond Python, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
